Meet Koby Conrad, the innovative mind behind the Sunflower app, a groundbreaking platform designed to help individuals conquer addictions ranging from alcohol to gambling. In this episode, Koby delves into his unique approach to influencer marketing that skyrocketed the app to a million-dollar annual recurring revenue in just 10 months. 

He shares how hiring Eric, a top influencer known as Mr. Impulsive, as the VP of Sobriety, transformed their growth strategy by leveraging his massive reach to drive significant app engagement.

Koby also reveals the secrets behind Sunflower’s AI therapy companion, Sam, which has handled over four million messages, achieving feats previously unimaginable in digital behavioral health. Viewers will gain insights into innovative UGC and influencer strategies, the evolving landscape of subscription apps, and how AI technology is reshaping mental health support. 

Whether you're interested in tech for good, app monetization, or AI mental health innovation, Koby’s journey offers invaluable lessons for app founders and investors alike.
